{"code": "import numpy as np

# Manual z-test for proportions
# Convert the data manually
email_converted = filtered_sales[filtered_sales['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].sum()
email_total = len(filtered_sales[filtered_sales['channel'] == 'email'])
paid_search_converted = filtered_sales[filtered_sales['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].sum()
paid_search_total = len(filtered_sales[filtered_sales['channel'] == 'paid_search'])

# Proportions
p1 = email_converted / email_total
p2 = paid_search_converted / paid_search_total

# Pooled proportion
p_pooled = (email_converted + paid_search_converted) / (email_total + paid_search_total)

# Standard error
se = np.sqrt(p_pooled * (1 - p_pooled) * (1/email_total + 1/paid_search_total))

# Z-statistic
z_stat = (p1 - p2) / se

# Two-sided p-value
p_value = 2 * (1 - np.abs(z_stat))

print(f'Z-statistic: {z_stat:.4f}')
print(f'P-value: {p_value:.4f}')"}
